offers.sn: POSITION OVERVIEW Job Summary The IT Support Technician II serves as the primary on-site technical support resource for the Naples location, providing day-to-day support for end users, devices, and local technology infrastructure.
offers.rq: Associate's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 2–5 years of experience providing desktop support, helpdesk support, or IT technical support. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field.
